claim: In `cot_series_rep`, the new `rw [one_div] at *` does nothing useful. Every `1 / _` in `h0` and inside the sums sits under a binder, so `rw` can only turn the goal's `1 / x` into `x⁻¹`, and the closing `ring` does not need that. The `have h0` is also used only once.
requested_change: Drop `rw [one_div] at *` and inline `h0`: `rw [tsum_pnat_eq_tsum_succ (f := fun n ↦ 1 / (x - n) + 1 / (x + n)), ← cot_series_rep' hz]` followed by `ring`.
evidence: Goal `π * cot (π * x) = 1 / x + ∑' n : ℕ+, (1 / (x - n) + 1 / (x + n))`. `cot_series_rep'` (Cotangent.lean:210) has right-hand side `∑' n : ℕ, (1 / (x - (n + 1)) + 1 / (x + (n + 1)))`, which matches the generalised `tsum_pnat_eq_tsum_succ`'s right-hand side `f (↑n + 1)` with `R = ℂ` without any `one_div` normalisation.
